title: No drift allowed: LangChain's context playbook with Hex
description:
How LangChain grew self-serve analytics questions 40x by giving its AI agent layered context with dbt, Hex, and a semantic layer. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Emily Hawkins and Logan Cochran of LangChain show how they keep an AI analytics agent accurate as the business changes. They layer dbt project docs, Hex workspace guides, a semantic layer, and endorsed source-of-truth models, and rewrite column descriptions for an AI audience. The payoff is a 40x increase in self-serve analytics questions, with the data team shifting from answering questions to owning the context.

In this session you'll learn:
• How to layer context so an analytics agent stays grounded
• How to write column descriptions that AI can use
• How endorsements mark trusted models

Speakers: Emily Hawkins, head of analytics engineering; Logan Cochran, analytics engineer; LangChain

Learn more about the dbt Semantic Layer: https://www.getdbt.com/product/semantic-layer

#dbt #dbtSummit2026 #AIAnalytics
